test_join_right: test the Index.join method with how='right' on int64 indices including non-unique cases
test_join_non_int_index: test the Index.join method between int64 and object dtype indices with all join types
test_join_outer: test the Index.join method with how='outer' on monotonic and non-monotonic int64 indices
test_uint64_join_inner: test the Index.join method with how='inner' on large uint64 indices
test_uint64_join_left: test the Index.join method with how='left' on large uint64 indices
test_uint64_join_right: test the Index.join method with how='right' on large uint64 indices
test_uint64_join_non_int_index: test the Index.join method between uint64 and object dtype indices
test_uint64_join_outer: test the Index.join method with how='outer' on large uint64 indices
